caseName: United States ex rel. Brown v. Cooke
caseNameFull: The United States ex rel. Frederick Brown v. Frederick A. Cooke, Superintendent of the County Prison at Philadelphia
summary: Appeal from the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. G. Edward Dickerson for the appellant. Mr. Thomas H. Peeples and Mr. Fred H. Dominick for the appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 241, Judicial Code; Whitney v. Dick, 202 U. S. 132; Lau Ow Bew v. United States, 144 U. S. 47, 58; Kurtz v. Moffitt, 115 U. S. 487, 498.
